title: YouTube AdFree
shortDescription: Ad-free YouTube with hardened feed ad blocking, Shorts removed, and sponsored playback overlays suppressed.
description: YouTube AdFree built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3 with GTV patches that harden Home/feed ad filtering against fresh-launch timing, wrapped renderer shapes, continuations, and known masthead/promotion renderer variants; extend the existing Remove Shorts option across Home, Search, subscriptions, channel/browse shelves, pagination, and continuation responses; suppress inline playback promotion surfaces that can present QR-code and Shop overlays; and harden the inherited playback JSON hook so unrelated JSON.stringify calls retain native behavior and avoid unnecessary deep cloning.

added: Shorts removal throughout Home, Search, subscriptions, channel and browse shelves, pagination, and continuation results.
Suppression of inline QR-code and Shop overlays during video playback.
fixed: Sponsored Home masthead and feed ads escaping AdBlock during fresh app loads or alternate response schemas.
The playback JSON hook so unrelated JSON.stringify calls keep native behavior and avoid unnecessary deep cloning.
